'''Poleine''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]] in a [[Mirror World]], where she served as a [[Sitter]] in the [[Hall of the Tower]] around {{ne|850}}.
== History ==
[[Elayna]] Sedai is raised to [[Amyrlin Seat]] while Poleine is away from the White Tower on a foreign mission

She is believed to have been close to uncovering the secret to unlocking a certain [[Portal Stone]]. She was later captured by the [[Black Ajah]] and rescued by Elayna.<ref name="videogame">''[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|The Wheel of Time]]</ref>
